theorem IsOrtho.map (f : E →ₗᵢ[𝕜] F) {U V : Submodule 𝕜 E} (h : U ⟂ V) : U.map f ⟂ V.map f := by
  classical
  rw [isOrtho_iff_inner_eq] at h ⊢
  intro u hu v hv
  rcases hu with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  rcases hv with ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
  simpa using h u hu v hv
